statements.text: 115-0045 1-19-16 Akabane, Kita, Tokyo(295m from Akabane-iwabuchi)View map
A restaurant serving domestic eel and fresh guinea fowl

A traditional Japanese-style interior creates a calm, nostalgic atmosphere. The restaurant offers table seating on the first floor and tatami seating upstairs, making it ideal for entertaining and banquets. Guests can enjoy eel and guinea fowl dishes such as unaju, sashimi, and yakitori, with the unaju especially popular for its tender meat and crispy skin.

capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds candidates and authoritative request conditions

capabilities.name: CHECK_AVAILABILITY

importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; schedule values are never Agent-supplied; at most three unchecked candidates per read batch.

capabilities.name: END_READ

capabilities.inputSchema: no business fields; optional short decision summary is trajectory-only

capabilities.name: PRESENT_RESULTS

importantConstraints: Every task-critical fact, including each HARD criterion and availability, must have current trusted evidence.

capabilities.name: SELECT_CANDIDATE

capabilities.resultMeaning: Records the selection; it does not authorize or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: A selected offer must belong to the selected candidate.

capabilities.name: BOOK_RESERVATION

capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Creates a deterministic ActionProposal and waits for valid user authorization.
importantConstraints: Cannot authorize, commit, or claim success.

Buffet <120-minute limit> Seafood, Yakiniku & Japanese/Western/Chinese Buffet with 150+ Dishes Including King Crab + All-You-Can-Drink Alcohol150 items

Buffet with 120-minute alcoholic all-you-can-drink included In a hotel-style, all-buffet format, savor more than 150 dishes across genres — from Wagyu yakiniku and Taraba crab to sushi, Chinese and Japanese cuisine, plus desserts. Seafood Buffet Dining Ginza Happo's highlights include sushi prepared by chefs right before your eyes and a variety of piping-hot, freshly made dishes. At our lively live kitchen, chefs take pride in each offering, and the buffet is sure to delight all five senses. The refined space, harmonizing Japanese and Western elements, provides the perfect setting for your special moments.

Premium with Jumbo Lobster & Finest Uni — Over 150 Seafood, Yakiniku & Japanese/Western/Chinese Buffet + All You Can Drink Alcohol150 items

<Premium Luxury Buffet & 120-minute All-You-Can-Drink Included> Indulge in our ultimate premium course featuring an extra-large lobster and the finest uni. Savor over 150 gourmet selections, including Edomae sushi hand-pressed by master chefs, Hokkaido-sourced king crab, freshly fried tempura, aromatic Hamayaki (seashore-style grilled seafood), premium Yakiniku, authentic Chinese dishes, and an array of elegant desserts. Relax in a refined setting and enjoy this blissful experience accompanied by fine drinks.

Highlights at Seafood Buffet Dining Ginza Happo include sushi hand-formed by the chef before your eyes and a wide selection of freshly prepared, piping-hot dishes. In the lively live kitchen, chefs showcase their skills, making this buffet an experience that will delight all five senses. The refined space, harmonizing Japanese and Western elements, provides the perfect setting for your special time. *This plan is available only from 11:30 to 16:00.*
